BeacherZ/cdt-management.body:
# CDT-Management

**A web management panel built with Docker: single-instance keep-alive for Alibaba Cloud CDT preemptible instances + multi-instance joint shift rotation + DDNS + notifications.**

Three modules, each handling its own part without interfering with the others:

| Module | Function |
| --- | --- |
| **Single-instance keep-alive** | Automatically restarts an instance when it goes offline; a running window can be freely set |
| **Joint shift rotation** | Multiple instances are grouped together and take turns on duty, scheduled by working hours or days |
| **DNS** | Centralized management of domain records; each record is explicitly bound to one instance or one shift group |

Idle instances not included in any workflow can still be started and stopped manually.

**Instances are not limited to preemptible types. Pay-as-you-go and subscription instances work equally well; they just don't need "preemption recovery".**

## 🖥️Interface

Light / dark (`设置 → 常规设置 → 外观`, click to view full size)

Mobile (responsive layout, click to view full size)

## ✨Key Features

### Single-instance keep-alive

**Description**: An instance manages itself. If it goes down, it is brought back up. No shift rotation, and no touching other instances.

> Each patrol round (default 60 seconds; interval and start second are customizable) re-issues a start command whenever the instance is stopped, until it starts. No duplicate start command is issued while it is already starting.
>
> **Running window (optional)**: For example, run it only every day from 08:00–20:00, or only on days 1–16 of the month. If both are set, the intersection applies. An end time earlier than the start time means the window spans midnight into the next day (e.g. `20:00–06:00`). An end of `00:00` means until 24:00. Identical start and end means all day. Outside the window, it stops automatically; inside the window, it keeps itself alive automatically. **No notifications are sent at either boundary of the window.**

**Purpose**: Bring the instance back up as soon as it is lost to keep uptime high. A running window keeps it online only when needed, reducing costs.

### Joint shift rotation

**Description**: Multiple instances are grouped together and take turns on duty in sequence, with only one online at any given moment. Two scheduling cycles are available:

> **Daily cycle**: Enter each instance's working hours, or directly set a fixed 0–24 hour schedule. Rotation completes within 24 hours.
>
> **Monthly cycle**: Enter how many days each instance runs. On the 1st at 00:00, rotation starts from position 1, and the last position takes the remaining days of the month.
>
> **Handover order**: On-duty starts on time: at the scheduled time, the instance going on duty is started first. Off-duty does not jump ahead: the previous instance is stopped only after the next one is confirmed running.

**Purpose**: Joint rotation reduces the cost of multiple preemptible instances being online at the same time, and fully utilizes each instance's own free 200G CDT traffic package.

### Traffic protection

**Description**: Each instance has its own threshold and stops automatically when exceeded. A shift group first attempts failover and only trips the circuit breaker when all instances are over the limit.

> Two failover triggers: the on-duty instance's traffic reaches the threshold, or the on-duty instance is preempted and 3 attempts to restart it fail.

**Purpose**: Prevent any instance from burning through its traffic package.

### DNS

**Description**: One record binds to one instance or one shift group. When the target is running, if the public IP changes (IP changes on start, or a manual elastic IP replacement), the next patrol round automatically points the record to the new IP.

# CTX-Audit

**Deterministic code security fact engine · PR drift gate · Forensic tool surface for agents (MCP) · Audit console**

Deterministically answers four questions: **Does this PR introduce security drift?**, **Who has authentication on these endpoints?**, **Is there a reachable path from entry to sink?**, **Can a payload survive to reach the sink?**

It does not aim for general vulnerability discovery. Candidate chains and the fact layer are left to the LLM or a human for the final verdict. Every conclusion carries `provenance` and `uncertainty`, so it can be reviewed and falsified.

[English](https://github.com/BlkSword/CTX-Audit/blob/HEAD/README_EN.md)

## Positioning

CTX-Audit is a **fact engine**, not a vulnerability scanner:

| What it does | What it does not do |
|---|---|
| Enumerates endpoints and authentication coverage (declarative + middleware) | Claims "there is definitely a vulnerability here" |
| Compares base/head and outputs a PR drift verdict | Full SAST / rule stacking |
| Gives entry→sink reachable paths and chain tiers | Executes target code (dynamic verification requires explicit opt-in) |
| Infers payload state hop by hop (killed / may_survive / taint_lost) | Fully type- and alias-complete CPG data flow |
| Outputs reproducible curl/MockMvc verification skeletons | Automatically generates PoCs and attacks the target |
| Chains an entire audit round into a workflow with evidence IDs | Replaces human judgment |

**Design principles**: zero build, sub-second, deterministic (identical input gives byte-identical output across runs), and every fact carries provenance and uncertainty.

# Enterprise Support Agent V2｜企业售后智能客服 Agent

A full-stack Python Agent demo project for after-sales scenarios. It shows how natural-language requests can be connected to traceable, evaluable business workflows with permission boundaries. The project migrates from a Dify workflow to code implementation, covering FastAPI, SQLite, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, automated testing, Docker, and a Vue demo interface.

## Project Highlights

- **End-to-end request chain**: fictional requester/approver identities and tenant validation → FastAPI → LangGraph deterministic routing → SQLite read-only orders, policy RAG, local simulated logistics HTTP API, or demo approval → structured replies and run records.
- **Verifiable policy Q&A**: policy source citations, evidence display, safe degradation when no evidence is found, and constraint rules for refund time limits, quality issues, logistics, and privacy boundaries.
- **Reliability and security boundaries**: tenant isolation, demo approver roles, self-approval rejection, prompt-injection refusal, checkpoint integrity pre-checks, lock files, and CI.
- **Runnable demo interface**: a Vue 3 + Vite page uses the existing FastAPI endpoints to experience conversation, order cards, policy evidence, and approval demos.
- **Learning materials and acceptance evidence**: a five-chapter code guide, a fault case library, a requirements traceability matrix, and runtime verification records.

## Project Positioning

This repository is a personal learning and technical demo project. It uses fictional data and fixed demo identities, and is not a production customer-service system. Order queries are read-only; refund approvals only record `approved_demo` and do not refund, change addresses, or delete data. Real identity authentication, production-grade RBAC, and multi-instance deployment are out of scope for the current version.

**Tech stack:** Python 3.12 · FastAPI · SQLite · LangChain · LangGraph · Chroma · SiliconFlow/Qwen · Vue 3 · Vite · Docker

**Current verification summary:** Previously, 55 GitHub Actions items passed; stage 15 WSL 12 acceptance items and the real `/api/chat` chain were reported as passing by the user on their own machine. # SuperMimic-Agent-WFArm

**English · [简体中文](https://github.com/Robot-Nav/SuperMimic-Agent-WFArm/blob/HEAD/README_CN.md)**

An exploratory open-source project on **wheel-legged mobile manipulation**. It studies how a four-wheel, four-leg platform and a six-joint arm can share a learned dynamics model, how a fixed-base arm can learn pose reaching and trajectory tracking, and how generated references can support that learning. Discussion, experiments and contributions are welcome.

The main learning mechanism comes from [SuperMimic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28480): fit a differentiable world model to real simulator transitions, then optimize the policy through short imagined rollouts. A [MimicAgent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24145)-style frontend proposes reference motions and checks them before they enter training.

This repository distributes training and evaluation code. Robot descriptions, meshes, calibration, datasets, checkpoints, videos and internal experiment reports are supplied separately or kept private. Full WF-Arm simulation requires authorized robot assets. The asset-free tests run without them.

# Heluo (河洛) · Heluo Forge

Heluo Forge (河洛) is designed for enterprise employees and combines an **enterprise-grade intelligent R&D platform** with an **intelligent personal assistant**. Within a personal work environment hosted by the DeepSeek Harness (DSH), it connects requirements, code, and delivery, and also links email, communication, office tools, and professional collaboration.

By extending existing capabilities, Heluo reuses the enterprise's current identity, model, and business systems, so the personal work experience aligns with enterprise permissions, data, and governance requirements. [View high-resolution blueprint](https://github.com/hrygo/heluo-forge/blob/HEAD/docs/assets/product-blueprint.svg) · [Understand the value proposition](#价值主张) · [Explore product direction](#产品方向) · [View product roadmap](#产品路线图) · [Read project documentation](#了解更多)

---

## Value Proposition

Large models upgrade across generations roughly every six months, and the Agent runtime host (Harness) keeps evolving on a weekly basis. To judge whether an enterprise intelligent R&D and personal assistant platform has long-term value, the key question is not whether it "runs today," but whether, as models get stronger and hosts are frequently upgraded or even switched to different runtimes, the existing platform and organizational investment **appreciates over time or depreciates quickly**.

Industry practice and engineering experience both confirm that "brittle scaffolding" (relying on hand-written prompt chains, rigid process templates, and modifications to the host kernel) often fails quickly after a model generation change or host evolution, and can even become a burden that hinders the model. Based on this, Heluo establishes a clear product and architecture value orientation:

> **Place value in “organizational and personal facts that resist decay” and in “open standard interfaces,” rather than in “prompt scaffolding” and “host-specific adaptations.”**

[View high-resolution value matrix](https://github.com/hrygo/heluo-forge/blob/HEAD/docs/assets/value-proposition-matrix.svg)

# reArtex

This project is a secondary development of artex. Within a stricter security boundary, it also incorporates some of my own understanding.

# Build in Public

If you came across this project on your timeline, feel free to stop and chat. Whether it's a debate about architecture, supplementary verification of a specific defect, or a reminder like “you could make this simpler here,” all of it is valuable input for me. PRs and issues are welcome from fellow practitioners.

## What is it

reArtex is an autonomous penetration testing system driven by LLM multi-agents: a Go monolithic backend (with an embedded Next.js frontend) + PostgreSQL, with agent capabilities provided by the norma SDK.

## What it does

- **Target decomposition**: the planner reads the exploration graph situation, judges targets, and dispatches intents; a worker claims one intent, executes it with real tools, writes new assets, facts, and vulnerabilities back, and then stops.
- **Dual graphs**: an exploration graph (the thinking and progression chain for each task) + an asset graph (a shared ground-truth store of assets across tasks), connected by anchors. You can see from the exploration direction which assets were tested, and from an asset trace back to which intents tested it and what was concluded.
- **Human in the loop**: conversational intervention, approval gates, steer corrections, traffic recording, and evidence retention.
- **Vulnerability retesting**: an independent retest Agent session, with conclusions of “still reproducible / fixed / unable to confirm.”
- **Asset sync**: imports assets from ScopeSentry and merges them into the asset graph by company asset scope.

## What do I need to prepare?

You need a NAS that can run Docker, an Android playback device or a computer browser, and a microphone and speakers connected to the playback device. 好好唱 handles music playback. It does not provide phone recording, microphone monitoring, or singing scoring. A Windows PC is an optional acceleration device.

The NAS main image supports amd64 and ARM64. PC GPU separation requires an NVIDIA graphics card that supports CUDA.
